verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a sandbox timeout or idle-timeout setting, or any automatic shutdown on idle or completion. Per-second billing and 'ephemeral' environments relate to the billing goal but are not a configurable timeout, and the Sandbox constructor parameters shown (gpu, cloud, region, cpu, memory) include no timeout. The axis clearly applies to a sandbox provisioning product, so missing evidence means none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set timeouts so sandboxes shut down automatically and stop billing when idle or done
